Here are a few practical ways to improve (and diagnose) your phone’s battery life:

1) **Find the culprit (Battery usage screen):** Check which apps/devices are using the most power and look for anything new that started draining battery recently.
2) **Reduce always-on costs:** Turn down **screen brightness**, shorten **screen timeout**, and enable **Battery Saver/Low Power Mode**.
3) **Stop background drain:** Disable/reduce **background app refresh** and background activity for apps that don’t need it; limit **Location Services** to “While Using” when possible.
4) **Connectivity tweaks:** If you’re in weak-signal areas, your phone may drain faster—use **Wi‑Fi** when available and consider **Airplane Mode** temporarily when signal is poor.
5) **Update + reboot:** Install any OS/app updates and do a reboot if you’ve not recently—battery drain can be caused by glitches.
6) **Check battery health if it’s old:** If your battery is aging, software optimizations may not fully help—check **battery health** and consider service if it’s significantly degraded.
7) **Make charging easy while traveling:** Since you already have a **portable power bank** and **wireless charging pad**, keep them organized for quick top-ups (so you’re not waiting until the phone is very low). Also avoid charging while the phone is hot.
